summary: FD_TC_079_No Travel Origin, Safety (arrival delay code 43, non-scheduled maintenance), APPR, Basic Aeroplan
title: No Travel Origin, Safety (arrival delay code 43, non-scheduled maintenance), APPR, Basic Aeroplan
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours by arrival delay code 43. Maintenance Control ordered an unscheduled special inspection of the aircraft operating AC 470 at YUL, and the aircraft couldn't depart until it was finished (required for safety). The customer chose not to travel and stayed at the origin. Checks that DDS classes code 43 as Safety and returns NE-14 (no cash compensation; expenses plus full refund entitlement), and that the linked Aeroplan Basic profile (tier A) is shown but doesn't change the outcome.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC067: one adult passenger, �mile Gagnon. One AC domestic leg: AC 470, YUL?YYZ, May 31, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:15 (255 min late). Actual arrival 16:20 (260 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 43 (TN). First departure delay code 43 (TN). No other delay codes on the MSL. Inspection done on the operating aircraft at YUL, not upline. Passenger not boarded, coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted. Aeroplan: linked, tier code A (Aeroplan Basic). No expense receipts. Fallback: FALSE. Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed within 366 days.
